detaileddescription.para: One row per monitored rail. This table is the only place where rails are defined; power.h/power.c derive the rail enum, the name strings, the I2C addresses, the power-good group and the protection limits from it.

Columns:
name: identifier suffix, also used as display name
addr: 7-bit I2C address on the PMBus (A0/A1 strapping)
pg: power-good / ALERT net the device is wired to (pwrPgLine_t)
vov: bus over-voltage limit [V]
iov: over-current limit [A]
tov: over-temperature limit [degC]

simplesect.para: The number of rows must match INA745A_NUM_INSTANCES in userDef.h.

briefdescription.para: Power functions of the board: FMC Vadj regulators (tpsm8286x) and the power monitors (ina745a).

detaileddescription.para: Rails, I2C addresses, power-good groups and protection limits are defined by PWR_MON_TABLE below; the rail enum is generated from it.

Protection concept:
Over-voltage, over-current and over-temperature limits are armed with a latched alert (ALATCH = 1). Under-voltage/under-current protection is not used on this board.
The ALERT pins are wired-OR onto the power-good inputs, so a fault appears as a power-good line going low. pwr_checkAlerts() reads those lines first (no bus traffic) and only queries the devices of an affected group over I2C.
Reading DIAG_ALRT clears the latch in the device, therefore the module keeps a sticky fault shadow (see pwr_mon_getFaults()).
